title: Net quantity declared in the dimension the commodity is sold in
plain: The quantity is measured in the right way for this product
plain_action: Check the quantity is given by weight for a solid, volume for a liquid, length for goods sold by length, or number for goods sold by count.

citation.text: The net quantity shall be expressed in the unit of weight, measure or number appropriate to the commodity. Screening of the declared dimension only; whether the chosen dimension is the one prescribed for this particular commodity requires the applicable schedule.

messages.pass: The net quantity is expressed in a recognised dimension of weight, volume, length or number.
messages.violation: The net quantity is not expressed in a recognised dimension of weight, volume, length or number.
messages.inconclusive: The dimension of the declared quantity could not be established from the reading; verify the printed unit.

sources.review_status: primary source reviewed; screening paraphrase; incomplete consolidation
